top_signals.title: China’s CMOC Sees Earnings Soar on Copper Rally and More Output
top_signals.summary: Chinese miner CMOC Group Ltd.’s earnings for the first nine months of the year surged 68% as copper prices soared toward a record.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: How Big Law Makes Billions: The Power of Law Firm Leverage
top_signals.summary:
How do some big law firms generate billions of dollars in revenue? This video explains law firm leverage, the economic model that allows equity partners to scale their work through teams of lawyers and associates and how artificial intelligence could change it all. 
 (Produced by Paul Detrick; Senior Producer Andrew Satter; Executive Producer Josh Block) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indian tech company eMudhra announces withdrawal from certificate business after security incident
top_signals.summary: The issue was publicized by cybersecurity researcher Scott Helme, who published a blog saying that instead of a random 384-bit number, one of the company's private keys was just the number four.
